CONTENTS

 

Results of the Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders

 

At the extraordinary general meeting of shareholders held on May 20, 2026 (the “Meeting”), the shareholders of the Registrant duly approved all agenda items as originally proposed, other than Item 4, which was not brought to a vote of the shareholders following the resignation of the relevant directors, as reported by the Registrant in its Report on Form 6-K that was furnished to the Securities and Exchange Commission on May 19, 2026.

 

Among other things, the Meeting resolved to amend the Registrant’s Amended and Restated Articles of Association. The Registrant’s updated Amended and Restated Articles of Association, as so amended, are attached as Exhibit 99.1 to this Report on Form 6-K.
